description: Upgrade the integrated fast-n=32/n=352 four-size solver from paired to exact block-four reflector fusion: reconcile the four-CTA coupling and 32x16 backtransform with the cleaned cooperative reducer code, preserve 29-family n=32 and 33-family n=352 stress coverage plus n=512 repair paths, remove superseded symbols, and profile all custom sizes.

Build and all 39 official tests pass. Full geomean is 37865.094 us versus first-parent 37835.652 within noise; target n352 improves from 6577.836 to 6522.348 us, with n32=68.668, n176=993.716, and n512 terms unchanged within noise.

Final commit ae23ca6805a80857cba9efd8ef391fd353579c86 integrates the second parent's exact four-reflector compact-WY-equivalent path into the first parent's cleaned robust four-size solver: four 256-thread coupling CTAs, six cross-products per group, 32x16 pitch34 shared backtransform, and exact paired tail. The superseded pair-coupling symbol is removed; n32, n176, cooperative n352 reduction/certification, and n512 dispatch/repair code are unchanged. Build and all 39 official tests pass. Final full geomean is 37865.094 us versus first-parent 37835.652 within run noise; n352 is 6522.348 us versus 6577.836. Targeted checks pass 29/29 n32 families, 33/33 n352 families with 59/66 raw n352 matrices selectively flagged then repaired, and 11/11 representative n512 repair families. Final-SHA nsys profiles cover all custom sizes: n32 fused/classifier=59.727/4.013 us; n176 reducer/solve=467.923/394.384 us; n352 reducer/panel/block-four-backtransform/Sturm/inverse/coupling=3595.075/1249.141/820.371/152.327/91.700/18.405 us; n512 reducer/solve=54.972/18.928 ms. Keep exploring exact block-eight reflector grouping, coupling generation fused into the reducer's terminal work, or a new cooperative n352 reducer organization; the 3.595 ms reducer and 1.249 ms panel QR are the largest measured target phases.
